result_text:
I fixed the false -100% average order value change. `averageOrderValueChangePercent()` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/model/YearOverYearSales.java` now returns null when the current month has no orders. That matches what it already did when last year had none, and I updated the Javadoc to say so. I didn't add a test for the zero-order case.

The revenue change is untouched, so it still shows -100% in that case. A region going from 20.00 to 40.00 still shows +100%. I ran the full suite with `mvn -q -o test` and it passed with no output. I haven't committed anything.
